project.name: Loredia
project.summary: Six daily games; daily rank points

about.text: Six daily games; daily rank points

tests.scenario: G1 first-play flow: The Fog without an account
tests.inputs: open /en/lol/the-fog/, click ENTER THE FOG, guess Teemo
tests.patch: not shown (clue 1 cites regions 'as of Oct/2026'); 173 champions
tests.expected: play without account; rules stated before play
tests.actual: intro text explains clue/clock/serious-miss rules; one click to start; first guess accepted via type-ahead box and Enter;

tests.scenario: G3 hint logic: guess consistent with open clues
tests.patch: not shown (clue 1 cites regions 'as of Oct/2026'); 173 champions
tests.expected: +5 minutes, no serious miss, new clue (per on-page rules)
tests.actual: '+05:00 Missed, but it made sense. New clue! Teemo matched all the open clues.' Clue 2 'I have animal (or yordle) ears' -> possible 13; misses 0 of 4;

tests.scenario: G3 hint logic: guess contradicting clue 1
tests.patch: not shown (clue 1 cites regions 'as of Oct/2026'); 173 champions
tests.expected: +10 minutes and a serious miss; the contradiction explained; Garen is from Demacia which has more than 10 champions
tests.actual: '+10:00 Missed, it doesn't match clue 1. It cost double, but a clue opened. Garen doesn't match clue 1: is from Demacia, which has 15 champions.' misses 1 of 4;…

tests.patch: not shown (clue 1 cites regions 'as of Oct/2026'); 173 champions
tests.expected: a result screen with rank, streak and sharing
tests.actual: VICTORY: Yuumi the Magical Cat; daily rank Diamond at 15:00 on the clock; title 'First Blood'; streak '1 day in a row';

tests.inputs: click ACCEPT!, press Enter on 'Preparing challenge'
tests.patch: not shown (clue 1 cites regions 'as of Oct/2026'); 173 champions
tests.expected: round starts after a short load
tests.actual: stayed at 'PREPARING CHALLENGE #6 0%' for more than 12 s; round not played

tests.scenario: G8 mobile spot check at 390 px, The Fog
tests.patch: not shown (clue 1 cites regions 'as of Oct/2026'); 173 champions
tests.actual: scrollWidth 390; viewport meta includes viewport-fit=cover, no zoom lock; 50 visible controls, minimum dimension 18 px, 28 under 32 px

tests.inputs: compare 'TODAY' date and storage key with UTC date
tests.patch: not shown (clue 1 cites regions 'as of Oct/2026'); 173 champions
